name: gmail_mail_client
title: Gmail Mail Client
description: Empty AdaOS desktop canvas ready for Builder authoring.

llm_hints.description: Create a new private AdaOS Application named "Gmail Mail Client" from scratch. It must be CBS-compatible. Its semantic application requires capability:mail.messages.manage version ^1.0.0 without naming Gmail, a package, a skill, or credentials. For the first beta, implement an application-local Gmail binding. The UI must provide inbox search and filters, message reading, labels, archive, trash, compose and send, connection/setup status, explicit least-privilege disclosures, and deterministic empty/loading/error/permission-denied states. Account credentials and OAuth tokens must never be stored in UI state or logs. Keep shared provider reuse and a global capability registry out of this first stage.
